meta.name: Home, Sweet Home
meta.description:
John Howard Payne (Henry B. Walthall) leaves home and begins a career in the theater. 
Despite encouragement from his mother and his sweetheart (Lillian Gish), Payne begins to lead a life of dissolute habits, and this soon leads to ruin and misery.
In deep despair, he thinks of better days, and writes a song that later provides inspiration to several others in their own times of need.
